name: Thomas Chacra
subtitle: QHSE Engineer Trainee, DEME Group
title: Bioengineer | Environmental management systems, audits & risk review
summary: Bioengineer who has worked inside management systems rather than beside them: ISO 14001 and 45001 requirements, gap analyses, environmental indicators and the documentation an audit actually asks for. Safety and environment are the same discipline of rigour, and I want to build a career where the two meet.

experience.title: Sustainability Adviser
experience.context: Compostable packaging and sustainable supply chains
bullets: Documented the assumptions and data sources behind an ISO 14067 carbon model, so that every figure could be defended to an external reviewer.
Structured supplier and freight records into one consistent dataset, and identified where the data was too weak to support a claim.

experience.title: ESG & Sustainability Analyst
bullets: Trained myself on ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 requirements and took part in training-aided gap analyses against those standards.
Built sustainability KPI frameworks and environmental performance indicators used to monitor sites and flag deviations.
Controlled the quality of environmental data and documented the validation rules, so that non-conformities could be traced rather than corrected ad hoc.

experience.title: Research and Development Scientist
bullets: Ran risk-aware analyses on energy and environmental data, and documented protocols so that results stayed reproducible across campaigns.
Worked with engineers and agronomists on resource-efficiency initiatives, turning measurements into operating rules.

experience.title: Energy and Environmental Consultant
bullets: Assessed environmental and regulatory constraints for energy projects, including compliance with regional rules for building performance.

sidebar.heading: Key skills
paras:
Management systems: ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001, gap analysis, documentation, corrective action follow-up.
Environment: GHG Protocol, ISO 14067, environmental indicators, regulatory constraints.
Risk: data quality control, deviation analysis, reproducible protocol design.

sidebar.heading: Field & reporting
paras: Field exposure in agricultural production and industrial sites. Comfortable writing procedures and training colleagues in them.
